connector.name: Itcons.app
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to Itcons.app work orders, reports, projects, users, and resources.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.itcons.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the itcons-app account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ITCONS_DOMAIN
env.description: Itcons.app tenant domain, for example 'demo' for https://demo.itcons.app.

env.name: ITCONS_USERNAME
env.description: Itcons.app username or email for local stdio usage.

env.name: ITCONS_PASSWORD
env.description: Itcons.app password for local stdio usage.

env.name: ITCONS_TOKEN
env.description: Existing Itcons.app bearer token. Can be used instead of username and password.
